name.en: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
name.hi: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना (एबी-पीएमजेएवाई)

ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

description.en: World's largest health insurance scheme providing ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization. Covers 1,929 treatment packages including surgery, day care, and ICU.
description.hi: दुनिया की सबसे बड़ी स्वास्थ्य बीमा योजना जो द्वितीयक और तृतीयक अस्पताल के लिए प्रति परिवार प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख प्रदान करती है।

shortDescription.en: ₹5 lakh health cover per family for 1,929 treatment packages.
shortDescription.hi: 1,929 उपचार पैकेज के लिए प्रति परिवार ₹5 लाख स्वास्थ्य कवर।

purpose: Providing health coverage to poor and vulnerable families
applicationProcess: Check eligibility on pmjay.gov.in. Visit empaneled hospital with Aadhaar card. No pre-registration required for eligible families. Cashless and paperless treatment.

ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

description.en: Safe motherhood intervention providing cash assistance to poor pregnant women for institutional delivery. Covers transportation and delivery expenses at government health facilities.
description.hi: संस्थागत प्रसव के लिए गरीब गर्भवती महिलाओं को नकद सहायता प्रदान करने वाली सुरक्षित मातृत्व हस्तक्षेप।

shortDescription.en: Cash assistance for institutional delivery to poor pregnant women.
shortDescription.hi: गरीब गर्भवती महिलाओं को संस्थागत प्रसव के लिए नकद सहायता।

purpose: Promoting institutional delivery and reducing maternal mortality
applicationProcess: Register at nearest government health facility. Delivery at government hospital or empaneled facility. Cash incentive disbursed through DBT after delivery.

description.en: Provides quality generic medicines at affordable prices through Janaushadhi Kendras across the country. Medicines available at 50-90% less than branded drug prices.
description.hi: देश भर में जनऔषधि केंद्रों के माध्यम से सस्ती कीमतों पर गुणवत्ता वाली जेनेरिक दवाएं प्रदान करता है। ब्रांडेड दवा की कीमतों से 50-90% कम पर दवाएं उपलब्ध।

shortDescription.en: Quality generic medicines at 50-90% less than branded prices.
shortDescription.hi: ब्रांडेड कीमतों से 50-90% कम पर गुणवत्ता वाली जेनेरिक दवाएं।

purpose: Making quality medicines affordable for all
applicationProcess: Visit any Jan Aushadhi Kendra with doctor's prescription. Purchase medicines at subsidized rates. No registration required.

ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

description.en: Umbrella scheme for health services including RMNCH+A, communicable diseases, non-communicable diseases, and health system strengthening. Provides free treatment at public health facilities.
description.hi: स्वास्थ्य सेवाओं के लिए छत्र योजना जिसमें आरएमएनसीएच+ए, संचारी रोग, गैर-संचारी रोग और स्वास्थ्य प्रणाली सुदृढ़ीकरण शामिल है।

shortDescription.en: Umbrella scheme for comprehensive health services at public facilities.
shortDescription.hi: सार्वजनिक सुविधाओं पर व्यापक स्वास्थ्य सेवाओं के लिए छत्र योजना।

purpose: Providing accessible and affordable healthcare to rural and urban populations
applicationProcess: Access free treatment at any government health facility under NHM. No separate registration required.

ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development

description.en: Maternity benefit scheme providing ₹5,000 cash incentive in three installments to pregnant and lactating mothers for first living child. Covers wages loss during pregnancy.
description.hi: गर्भवती और स्तनपान कराने वाली माताओं को पहले जीवित बच्चे के लिए तीन किश्तों में ₹5,000 नकद प्रोत्साहन प्रदान करने वाली मातृत्व लाभ योजना।

shortDescription.en: ₹5,000 maternity benefit in three installments for first child.
shortDescription.hi: पहले बच्चे के लिए तीन किश्तों में ₹5,000 मातृत्व लाभ।

purpose: Providing maternity benefit and compensating wage loss during pregnancy
applicationProcess: Register at nearest Anganwadi Centre or health facility. ₹1,000 on registration, ₹2,000 after 6 months pregnancy, ₹2,000 after child birth. DBT to bank account.
